scripts.check:css-layout: ! rg -n 'data-testid' --glob '*.css' src theme.css 2>/dev/null && ! rg -n 'data-testid' --glob '*.module.css' src && echo 'css-layout: ok'
scripts.preview:debug: VITE_STARC_DEBUG=1 npm run build && VITE_STARC_DEBUG=1 wrangler dev
scripts.arena: bash -c 'pnpm run arena:clean && mkdir -p ./arena-results && OUT="$PWD/arena-results" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing naive:strategic --seeds 10 --out "$OUT" "$@"' bash
scripts.arena:naive: bash -c 'pnpm run arena:clean && mkdir -p ./arena-results && OUT="$PWD/arena-results" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing naive:naive --seeds 10 --out "$OUT" "$@"' bash
scripts.arena:strategic: bash -c 'pnpm run arena:clean && mkdir -p ./arena-results && OUT="$PWD/arena-results" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing strategic:strategic --seeds 10 --out "$OUT" "$@"' bash
scripts.arena:all: bash -c 'pnpm run arena:clean && mkdir -p ./arena-results && OUT="$PWD/arena-results" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing naive:strategic --seeds 10 --out "$OUT" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing naive:naive --seeds 2 --out "$OUT" && ./scripts/arena.sh --pairing strategic:strategic --seeds 2 --out "$OUT"' bash
